notes.0: Finish the League tutorial. The 10 points unlock T1; choose Golden Touch immediately.
notes.32: Lumbridge Castle: talk to Hans and ask how old you are. Do it while circling the castle.
notes.219: Use the musician north of Lumbridge lodestone; leave as soon as the task fires.
notes.195: Pickpocket the nearest man/woman once; stay on the same NPC for the next two counters.
notes.199: Keep pickpocketing the same NPC until 5 total.
notes.196: Keep going to 10 total, then stop; do not turn this into a Thieving grind.
notes.197: Use the vegetable/bakery stall in Lumbridge market.
notes.198: Stay on that stall to 10 steals, then leave.
notes.188: Turn on Thick Skin/Rock Skin/Steel Skin now and let Prayer drain while you keep moving.
notes.189: Do not stand still for this—let the active prayer hit 0 during the market/church loop.
notes.216: Lumbridge general store: claim the free tinderbox.
notes.217: Sell that same free tinderbox straight back.
notes.218: Sell a spare bronze item from Bob's Axes; keep one hatchet.
notes.215: Kill one chicken; keep the bone for altar/bone counters.
notes.186: Bury exactly one bone now; bank later bones for altar tasks.
notes.220: Pick at least 3 wheat so flour/bread prep stays in one trip.
notes.839: Windmill: turn wheat into flour. Keep enough flour for bread.
notes.30: Milk a cow; keep the milk rather than dropping it.
notes.838: Mix flour + water into bread dough and bake it on the Lumbridge range.
notes.33: Finish The Blood Pact in Lumbridge catacombs; equip Caitlin's staff afterward.
notes.28: Kill one Lumbridge goblin. This is also the first Blessing-task type of content.
notes.214: Kill an imp only if a spawn is free; do not wait on competition.
notes.168: Chop one normal tree and keep the logs.
notes.165: Stay on the same trees until 5 chops.
notes.169: Stop at 10 basic logs unless you need a few more for Firemaking.
notes.820: Fletch one log into arrow shafts.
notes.173: Make a short fire line to 5 logs.
notes.27: Kill one giant rat in Lumbridge Swamp and keep its raw rat meat.
notes.37: Cook the rat meat on a campfire you lit yourself.
notes.35: Use the shrimp spot east of Lumbridge Swamp.
notes.176: First shrimp can overlap the local Lumbridge task.
notes.183: This completes inside the same shrimp batch.
notes.835: Cook five of the shrimp beside the spot.
notes.180: The first cooked shrimp should satisfy this.
notes.182: Deliberately burn one low-level food before Cooking gets too high.
notes.221: Right-click a copper/tin rock and prospect it.
notes.153: Start on copper in the south-east swamp mine.
notes.162: Stay in the same mine to 5 ore.
notes.156: Take tin to 10; keep ores/bars needed for later Smithing.
notes.136: The first skill to 20 ends the 50-task opener. Karamja unlocks now.
notes.17: Before Karamja, complete Stronghold of Player Safety for this 30-point task.
notes.594: Karamja sweep starts at the lodestone: collect 5 seaweed; drop/re-pick only if needed.
notes.601: Pick the nearby pineapple while still on the Brimhaven side.
notes.595: Musa Point plantation: pick 10 bananas, fill Luthas' crate, then talk to Luthas for 30 coins.
notes.597: Kill a snake while crossing the island; do not detour for a special spawn.
notes.602: Talk to Saniboch and pay exactly 875 coins to enter Brimhaven Dungeon.
notes.603: Cross the spiky pit on the stepping stones. Requirement: 12 Agility.
notes.600: Kill one greater demon inside the Karamja dungeon route.
notes.596: Brimhaven Agility Arena: tag a pillar and claim exactly one ticket; leave.
notes.614: Descend Karamja Volcano to TzHaar and kill one TzHaar.
notes.617: Musa Point: catch 25 lobsters. Keep going because the global 100-lobster counter stacks.
notes.607: On a full inventory, run south to Stiles and have him note the fish.
notes.894: Train only as far as needed for 50 Fishing, then catch 50 swordfish. This crosses 750 points in this route; choose Animal Wrangler.
notes.2: Climb Wizards' Tower to the top before entering Runespan.
notes.4: Runespan: siphon one fire essling at 14 Runecrafting, then leave unless another nearby task is cheap.
notes.1: Kill the Wizards' Tower lesser demon with a ranged/magic-capable setup; short-range melee cannot attack it.
notes.62: Take the Draynor portal and complete Necromancy!.
notes.66: At the City of Um ritual site, conjure the Skeleton Warrior.
notes.73: Complete a communion ritual with a memento.
notes.63: Upgrade one Death Skull/Deathwarden item to T20; use whichever 15 Smithing/Crafting requirement you already meet.
notes.3: Draynor: bring 4 balls of wool to Ned and have him make rope.
notes.98: Varrock south: kill one dark wizard while already travelling north.
notes.101: Use one banked bone on a Varrock stray dog.
notes.107: Steal one cup of tea from the Varrock tea stall; keep it.
notes.100: Take that cup upstairs to Elsie in Varrock church and hear her story.
notes.102: Grand Exchange: claim the free clue from Zaida; bank it rather than routing a region-leaking clue.
notes.104: Dig Site: finish the Archaeology tutorial; keep the journal for teleports.
notes.22: Fort Forinthry: once the workshop exists, use its bank.
notes.103: Give Bill a beer while doing the Fort construction loop.
notes.105: Put one normal log through the Fort sawmill yourself.
notes.23: Finish New Foundations and activate the Fort lodestone.
notes.115: Aubury/essence access: mine exactly 50 pure essence, bank it, leave.
notes.117: Varrock wisps: gather and convert 50 bright memories in one session.
notes.112: Enter the Cooks' Guild only if the 32 Cooking requirement is already met; the route's fish cooking should make this reasonable.
notes.116: Pickpocket a Varrock guard at 40 Thieving.
notes.144: Use Necromancy combat to reach combat 50; stop the dedicated combat push once the task fires.
notes.163: The 200-ore global counter should complete during the same mining block.
notes.828: Cash stored bars into 25 cheap metal weapon/armour pieces.
notes.911: Equip a complete steel armour set at 20 Defence.
notes.912: Equip a complete mithril armour set at 30 Defence.
notes.48: Cut the willow east of Lumbridge Castle. This route reaches T3 here; choose Voidwalker immediately.
notes.294: Bring 1,000 coins before starting the Desert loop. Use any magic carpet once.
notes.282: Enter Menaphos first and activate useful local travel while you are there.
notes.283: Het's Oasis: catch one whirligig and move on.
notes.288: Al Kharid mine: mine one gem rock.
notes.290: Kill one crocodile while crossing the Desert.
notes.292: Squish 10 corrupted scarabs; batch all 10 in one stop.
notes.285: Pyramid Plunder: open the Grand Gold Chest in room 1.
notes.286: Return when 31 Thieving is met and open the room 2 Grand Gold Chest.
notes.304: At 46 Thieving, steal once from the Menaphos lamp stall.
notes.312: Desert Treasure is listed among Desert auto-completed quests. Check that the task awards when the region unlocks; do not replay content that is already complete.
notes.291: Spirit kalphite pouch: bring a pouch, 51 spirit shards, a blue charm, and a potato cactus.
notes.297: Take the Kalphite Queen first kill when the combat setup is already stable; do not farm 25 yet.
notes.301: Do one Dominion Tower boss when access/setup is ready.
notes.307: Pontifex signet: 58 Archaeology plus a cut dragonstone (55 Crafting if you must cut it yourself).
notes.223: Asgarnia opens at 300 tasks. Start with one Burthorpe Agility lap.
notes.227: Goblin Village: kill one goblin raider boss.
notes.229: Falador park: sit with Sir Tiffy.
notes.230: Pray at Bandos's remains while passing through.
notes.231: Falador Party Room: dance once and leave.
notes.273: Bring Thurgo a redberry pie; 10 Cooking.
notes.235: Take one Giant Mole kill when already geared.
notes.238: Use Telekinetic Grab on the Wine of Zamorak south of Goblin Village; 33 Magic.
notes.239: Set up a dwarf multicannon once.
notes.240: Artisans' Workshop: finish one ceremonial sword.
notes.241: Mining Guild: mine one orichalcite rock at 60 Mining.
notes.242: Harvest one herb from the Troll Stronghold patch.
notes.280: Taverley dungeon: kill one blue dragon; use a dusty key or 70 Agility route.
notes.281: Open Taverley's crystal chest with a crystal key.
notes.45: Shattered Worlds: reach world 25 only when combat progression makes it a short block.
notes.236: The 25th Giant Mole kill is the 6,000-point crossing in this published route; choose Production Master.

1.label: Spawn
1.text: Start in Lumbridge. Keep the opener local; do not run across the map for isolated 10-point tasks.

2.label: Relic
2.text: At 10 points choose T1 Golden Touch immediately.

12.label: Shop
12.text: At Lumbridge market/general store, gather an empty pot, 2 buckets, a jug, 3 spare pots, shears and ~50 bait; claim a crayfish cage. Do not waste time price-shopping.

51.label: Cash
51.text: Karamja just unlocked. Run Stronghold of Security first and take the one-time 10,000 coins; this is route cash, not a League task.

51.label: Bank
51.text: Withdraw 875+ coins, an axe, lobster pot, harpoon, combat gear, food/prayer restoration and a few empty inventory slots. Then teleport/use unlocked travel to Karamja.

66.label: Relic
66.text: The swordfish task puts the route over 750 points. Choose T2 Animal Wrangler before doing more skilling.

72.label: Um shop
72.text: Before ritual batching, buy the basic ghostly ink/necroplasm you actually need for the listed rituals; bank the surplus. Do not buy speculative stacks.

113.label: Relic
113.text: The route is over 1,750 points. Choose T3 Voidwalker now, then use its travel benefit for the next sweeps.

176.label: Region
176.text: At 175 completed tasks unlock Kharidian Desert. Bring at least 1,000 coins for the carpet task before starting the local loop.

219.label: Relic
219.text: The next completed task crosses 3,500 points in this ordering. Choose T4 Crystal Grace as soon as the point popup lands.

301.label: Region
301.text: At 300 completed tasks unlock Asgarnia. Bank a redberry pie, runes for Telekinetic Grab, any crystal key, and your main combat setup before the first Falador/Taverley sweep.

326.label: Relic
326.text: The published Asgarnia sweep reaches 6,000 points at task 325. Choose T5 Production Master before processing any large production stacks.

393.label: Stop
393.text: Hard source gate: the currently published Easy/Medium corpus provides only 392 rows across Global + Misthalin + Havenhythe + Karamja + Desert + Asgarnia. You are 58 task slots short of the 450-region gate because Hard/Elite/Master are not public yet.
